title: Hello, Daddy!
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Values Integration Biblical role of a father , Eco-Stewardship Putting screens away for family , Christian Value God gave me my family
Target Vocabulary: Daddy, Family
Target Sentence: "Hello, Daddy."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will learn the word "Daddy," practice saying hello, and understand that Daddy is a special part of the family God gave them.
Classroom Strategies: Warm, joyful tone. Heavy use of TPR for greeting. The teacher should bring a family picture or a drawing of a father to class.

Values Integration: Teacher explicitly connects the role of a father to God's loving design for the family, emphasizing respect and love for Daddy.
Success Indicators: The student can point to the picture of Daddy on the screen, wave, and attempt to say "Hello, Daddy."

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome to RemoEd!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello everyone! [Wave both hands with a big smile] Welcome to RemoEd! My name is Teacher [Name]. Let's say hello to Ed, Sophia, and Remo! [Point to screen] Say: Hello! [Cup ear to listen for student]"

Slide 2 – Meet Daddy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Today, we have a very special person! [Look excited, hands on cheeks] Listen: Daddy. [Point to mouth] Da-ddy. Can you say Daddy? [Cup ear to listen] Very good! It is Daddy."

Slide 3 – Hello, Daddy!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at Daddy! [Point to screen] Let's say hello! [Wave hand big and wide] Say: Hello, Daddy. [Cup ear] Excellent! Hello, Daddy!"

Slide 4 – TPR Action: Big Hug
Teacher Script & TPR: "We love Daddy! Let's give Daddy a big hug! [Wrap arms around yourself and squeeze] Squeeze tight! We love you, Daddy!"

Slide 5 – Daddy is Strong
Teacher Script & TPR: "Wow! Look! Daddy is very strong. [Flex arm muscles playfully] Daddy helps us. Daddy protects us. Say: Strong Daddy! [Cup ear]"

Slide 6 – Eco/Tech: Bye-Bye Screen
Teacher Script & TPR: "When Daddy is here, what do we do? Do we look at the screen? No, no. [Shake head] We say bye-bye to the screen! [Wave goodbye to a pretend tablet] We play with Daddy!"

Slide 7 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who gave you your wonderful Daddy? [Point up to the sky] God did! God gave me Daddy! [Smile warmly] Thank you, God, for Daddy! [Clap hands together in a thankful gesture]"

Slide 8 – Game: Find Daddy!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! [Put hands up in excitement] Where is Daddy? [Put a hand over your eyes like you are searching] Can you touch Daddy? [Wait for the student to tap the screen] Yes! There is Daddy! [Give a thumbs up]"

Slide 9 – Game: Say Hello!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who is at the door? Is it Daddy? Touch the door! [Wait for the student to tap] It's Daddy! Wave and say: Hello, Daddy! [High-five the camera]"

Slide 10 – Real World Connection Where is Daddy?
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now it is your turn! [Point to the student] Is Daddy home? [Look expectantly] After class, go find Daddy! Give him a big hug and say: Hello, Daddy! [Demonstrate a hug]"

Slide 11 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You did so well today! Let's say it one more time. Say: Daddy! [Wait for response] Say: Hello, Daddy! [Wait for response] Great job!"

Slide 12 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned a Family Heart for your garden! [Cheer and clap loudly] Thank you for loving your family. It is time to say goodbye. [Wave both hands] Goodbye, see you next time! [Blow a kiss or wave until the camera turns off]"

title: Letter D is for Daddy
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Phonics short /d/ sound , Fine Motor Air tracing , Christian Value Thanking God for family
Target Vocabulary: D, d, Daddy
Target Sentence: "D-D-Daddy."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will visually recognize the uppercase 'D' and lowercase 'd', produce the /d/ sound, and associate the letter with the word "Daddy."
Classroom Strategies: Energetic phonetic repetition. The teacher should bounce their hand or tap their chin gently to emphasize the hard /d/ sound. Bring a 'D' flashcard to class.

Values Integration: Connect learning the letter D to the blessing of having a Daddy to lead and love the family.
Success Indicators: The student can point to the letter 'D' on the screen and attempt to repeat the /d/ sound and the word "Daddy."

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome Back!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello again! [Wave both hands with a big smile] Welcome back to RemoEd! Let's say hello to Ed, Sophia, and Remo. [Point to the characters on screen] Say: Hello! [Cup ear to listen for the student]"

Slide 2 – Meet Letter D
Teacher Script & TPR: "Today, we have a new letter! [Look surprised and excited] Look! This is the letter D. [Trace a big 'D' in the air with your finger] Big D. Small d. [Point to each on the screen] Can you say D? [Cup ear to listen]"

Slide 3 – The /d/ Sound
Teacher Script & TPR: "What sound does D make? Listen to me. [Point to your throat/mouth] /d/ ... /d/ ... /d/. [Make a crisp, bouncing D sound] Your turn! Say: /d/ /d/ /d/! [Point to the student and cup ear] Very good! [Clap hands]"

Slide 4 – D is for Daddy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look! /d/ /d/ Daddy! [Hold up a picture of a dad or a D flashcard] D is for Daddy. [Point to the letter D, then the Daddy] Say: Daddy! [Cup ear] Great job! D-D-Daddy!"

Slide 5 – TPR Action: Drumming for Daddy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's play the drum for Daddy! [Pretend to hold drumsticks and tap up and down] Say: /d/ /d/ Daddy! [Tap on each /d/ sound] /d/ /d/ Daddy! Wow, what a great song!"

Slide 6 – Tracing Big D
Teacher Script & TPR: "Magic finger ready! [Hold up index finger] Let's write big D! Straight line down! [Trace down] Now a big, big tummy! Curve all the way down! [Draw a large half-circle in the air] You do it!"

Slide 7 – Tracing Small d
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now small d! Make a circle! [Draw a small circle in the air] Now a tall line down! [Trace straight down beside it] Good job writing d!"

Slide 8 – Values Integration: Daddy Leads
Teacher Script & TPR: "Daddy holds our hand. Daddy leads the way. [Hold hand out like you are holding a child's hand] We listen to Daddy because he loves us! [Smile and nod]"

Slide 9 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "God gave us the letter D, and God gave us Daddy! [Point up to the sky] Let's say thank you. [Clap hands together gently] Say: Thank you, God, for Daddy! [Wait for the student to repeat]"

Slide 10 – Game: Find the Big 'D'!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! [Put hands up in excitement] Where is the Big D? [Put a hand over your eyes] Can you touch the Big D? [Wait for the student to point or tap the screen] Yes! There is the Big D! [Give a thumbs up]"

Slide 11 – Real World Connection Make a D!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now it is your turn! [Point to the student] Get your magic finger! Can you draw a D on your hand? [Demonstrate tracing on your own palm] Line down, big curve! Show me! Wow!"

Slide 12 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are so smart! Let's say it one more time. Say: D! [Wait for response] Say: /d/ /d/! [Wait for response] Say: Daddy! [Wait for response] Fantastic! [Clap loudly]"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned a D-block for your garden! [Cheer and celebrate] Look how smart you are getting! It is time to say goodbye. [Wave both hands] Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave until the camera turns off]"

title: The Round Circle
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Cognitive Shapes , Eco-Stewardship Nature's shapes , Christian Value God made shapes
Target Vocabulary: Circle, Round
Target Sentence: "It is a circle."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will identify the circle shape, use the word "round," and recognize circular objects in their environment.
Classroom Strategies: Exaggerated, sweeping arm motions to draw circles in the air. Bring a physical round object to class e.g., a ball or a small plate .

Values Integration: Teacher connects the circle shape to things God made in nature, like the sun and apples.
Success Indicators: The student can draw a circle in the air with their arms and say the word "Circle."

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome Back!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello! It is so good to see you! [Wave both hands with a big smile] Welcome back to RemoEd! Let's say hello to our friends. [Point to the screen] Say: Hello! [Cup ear to listen]"

Slide 2 – Meet the Circle
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at this! What is it? [Point to the screen] Listen: Circle. [Point to mouth] Say: Circle. [Cup ear] Very good! It is a circle!"

Slide 3 – The Circle is Round
Teacher Script & TPR: "The circle goes round and round! [Trace a circle in the air repeatedly] It has no corners. Listen: Round. [Point to mouth] Say: Round! [Cup ear] The circle is round."

Slide 4 – TPR Action: Make a Big Circle!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's make a big circle! [Put both arms over your head to form a large circle] Make it really big! Say: Big circle! [Cup ear] Wow, what a round circle!"

Slide 5 – Eco-Stewardship: The Sun is a Circle
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look up at the sky! [Point up] What shape is the sun? The sun is a circle! [Make a circle with arms] The sun is round and warm!"

Slide 6 – Eco-Stewardship: The Apple is Round
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at the yummy food! [Pretend to hold an apple] What shape is the apple? The apple is a circle! It is round! Crunch, crunch! [Pretend to bite]"

Slide 7 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who made the round sun? Who made the round apple? [Point up] God did! God made beautiful circles in nature. Thank you, God! [Clap hands together gently]"

Slide 8 – Game: Find the Circle!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! [Put hands up in excitement] Where is the circle? [Put hand over eyes like you are searching] Touch the round circle! [Wait for the student to tap the screen] Yes! You found it!"

Slide 9 – Game: Trace the Circle!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Magic finger ready! Let's trace the circle on the screen! Touch the screen! Go round and round! [Make a circular motion with your finger] Round and round!"

Slide 10 – Real World Connection Circle Hunt!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now it is your turn! [Point to the student] Look around your house! Can you find something round? Can you find a circle? [Wait enthusiastically while they look. Celebrate when they return with an object] Wow! It is a circle!"

Slide 11 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You did so well today! Let's say our words again. Say: Circle! [Wait for response] Say: Round! [Wait for response] Say: It is a circle! [Wait for response] Fantastic job! [Clap loudly]"

Slide 12 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned a round toy for your garden! [Cheer and celebrate] Look! It is a perfect circle! It is time to say goodbye. [Wave both hands] Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave until the camera turns off]"

title: Drawing Across
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Fine Motor Skills Horizontal tracing , Values Integration Connecting to family
Target Vocabulary: Across, Line
Target Sentence: "Across, across."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will practice drawing horizontal lines from left to right, combining fine motor skills with the concept of reaching out or connecting to family.
Classroom Strategies: Emphasize the horizontal motion using wide TPR movements. Have a whiteboard or a piece of paper and a thick marker ready to model drawing straight across.

Values Integration: Connect the action of drawing a line "across" to the idea of walking across a room to give family members a hug, reinforcing family bonds.
Success Indicators: The student can mimic the horizontal tracing motion with their finger from left to right and say "Across."

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome to RemoEd!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello everyone! [Wave both hands with a big smile] Welcome back to RemoEd! My name is Teacher [Name]. Let's say hello to Ed, Sophia, and Remo! [Point to screen] Say: Hello! [Cup ear to listen for student]"

Slide 2 – Look Left, Look Right!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's stretch our necks! Look this way! [Turn head sharply to the left] Now look that way! [Turn head sharply to the right] Good job!"

Slide 3 – The Line Goes Across
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at this! It is a line! [Point to the screen] This line goes across. Listen: Across. [Point to mouth] Say: Across. [Cup ear] Very good!"

Slide 4 – TPR Action: Zoom Across
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's be airplanes! Put your arms out! [Stretch arms out horizontally] Let's fly across! [Lean torso and arms from left to right smoothly] Say: Across, across! [Cup ear]"

Slide 5 – Motor Skill: Trace in the Air
Teacher Script & TPR: "Get your magic finger ready! [Hold up index finger on the left side of your body] Let's draw a line. Start here. Trace: Across, across, across! [Move finger smoothly from left to right]"

Slide 6 – Values Integration: Go to Daddy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look! Daddy is over there! Ed wants to give him a hug. Ed has to walk across the room! [Walk your fingers from left to right in the air] Go to Daddy!"

Slide 7 – On-Screen Tracing
Teacher Script & TPR: "Can you help Ed reach Daddy? Touch the screen! Draw across, across, across! [Wait for student to trace the horizontal line] Yay! Big hug! [Hug yourself]"

Slide 8 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "God gives us family to love. We hold hands and stay together. [Clasp your own hands together] Thank you, God, for our family! [Smile warmly]"

Slide 9 – Game: Fast Across, Slow Across
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's draw a fast line! [Trace across quickly from left to right] Across! Now a slow line. [Trace across very slowly] A-croooooss. Good job!"

Slide 10 – Game: Trace to the Circle
Teacher Script & TPR: "Oh look! A red circle! Trace the line to the circle: Across, across, across! [Wait for student interaction] You found the circle!"

Slide 11 – Real World Connection Paper Time
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now it is your turn! Do you have a paper and crayon? [Wait] Show me how you draw a line! Across, across, across! [Celebrate their drawing]"

Slide 12 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "Great job today! Say: Line! [Wait] Say: Across, across! [Wait] Say: Hello, Daddy! [Wait] Very good!"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned an Eco-Drop! Look, you built a path in your garden! Thank you for working so hard today. Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave enthusiastically until the camera turns off]"

title: Family Hunt & Week 1 Review
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Gamified Review, Formative Assessment
Target Vocabulary: Daddy, Circle, D
Target Sentence: "Daddy," "Circle," "D"
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Reinforce the concepts from Month 2, Lessons 1-4 Daddy, Letter D, Circle, Across .
Classroom Strategies: High energy and enthusiastic pacing. Use props: a picture of a father, a 'D' flashcard, and a round object.

Values Integration: Remind students of the importance of family, drawing connections between Daddy and the family path.
Success Indicators: Student can independently recall the target words when prompted with images or props and execute the correct TPR motions.

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome to Review Day!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello everyone! [Wave] Welcome back! Today is a special day. We are going on a Family Hunt! Are you ready? [Put hands to eyes like binoculars]"

Slide 2 – Word Review: Daddy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who is this special person? [Pause, point to screen] Yes! It is Daddy! Let me hear you say DADDY! [Cup ear]"

Slide 3 – Action Review: Hello, Daddy!
Teacher Script & TPR: "What do we say to Daddy? We wave! [Wave big] Say: Hello, Daddy! Now give a big hug! [Wrap arms around yourself and squeeze]"

Slide 4 – Phonics Review: Letter D
Teacher Script & TPR: "Do you remember this letter? It is D! [Trace D in air] What sound does it make? /d/ /d/ Daddy! [Pretend to play a drum] Say it with me: /d/ /d/ Daddy!"

Slide 5 – Shape Review: Circle
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at this shape! What is it? It is a circle! [Make a big circle with arms] Say: Circle! [Cup ear] The circle is round!"

Slide 6 – Action Review: Draw Across
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's draw a line! Magic finger ready! [Hold up finger] Trace from here to there! Across, across, across! [Trace horizontally in the air]"

Slide 7 – Game: The Daddy Hunt
Teacher Script & TPR: "Where is Daddy? Touch Daddy! [Wait for tap] Yes! There is Daddy! Give a thumbs up!"

Slide 8 – Game: Pop the D!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Pop the bubbles! Only pop the letter D! Touch D! [Wait for taps] Pop! Pop! Great job!"

Slide 9 – Game: Trace to the Circle
Teacher Script & TPR: "Can you help Ed find the round circle? Draw across! Across, across, across! [Trace horizontally on screen]"

Slide 10 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who gave us the round sun and our wonderful Daddy? God did! [Smile warmly and clasp hands] Thank you, God!"

Slide 11 – Real World Connection Scavenger Hunt
Teacher Script & TPR: "Quick! Stand up! Find something round in your house! A circle! Bring it to the camera! [Cheer loudly when they return with an object]"

Slide 12 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are a star! Say: Daddy! Say: Letter D! Say: Round Circle! Amazing!"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "An Eco-Drop for you! Look at the round toy in your garden! Goodbye, see you next week! [Wave]"

title: Hello, Mommy!
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Values Integration Biblical role of a mother , Eco-Stewardship Family time , Christian Value God gave me Mommy
Target Vocabulary: Mommy, Family
Target Sentence: "Hello, Mommy."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will learn the word "Mommy," practice saying hello, and understand that Mommy is a loving, nurturing part of the family God gave them.
Classroom Strategies: Extremely warm, loving tone. Emphasize gentle, caring TPR motions. Bring a picture of a mother to class.

Values Integration: Teacher connects the role of a mother to God's design for nurturing and care within the family structure.
Success Indicators: The student can point to the picture of Mommy, blow a kiss, and attempt to say "Hello, Mommy."

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome Back!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello everyone! [Wave both hands with a big smile] Welcome back to RemoEd! Let's say hello to our friends! Say: Hello! [Cup ear]"

Slide 2 – Meet Mommy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Today, we have another special person! [Put hands over heart] Listen: Mommy. [Point to mouth] Mo-mmy. Can you say Mommy? [Cup ear] Very good! It is Mommy."

Slide 3 – Hello, Mommy!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at Mommy! Let's say hello! [Wave hand gently] Say: Hello, Mommy. [Cup ear] Excellent! Hello, Mommy!"

Slide 4 – TPR Action: Blow a Kiss
Teacher Script & TPR: "We love our Mommy! Let's send Mommy a kiss! [Kiss palm and blow it toward the camera] Mwah! Say: I love you, Mommy!"

Slide 5 – Mommy is Gentle
Teacher Script & TPR: "Mommy is very gentle. [Stroke back of hand softly] Mommy takes care of us. She gives us hugs when we are sad. Say: Gentle Mommy! [Cup ear]"

Slide 6 – Eco/Tech: Bye-Bye Screen
Teacher Script & TPR: "When Mommy wants to play, what do we do? We say bye-bye to the phone! [Wave goodbye to a pretend phone] Bye-bye screen! Time for family!"

Slide 7 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who gave you your sweet Mommy? [Point up] God did! God gave me Mommy! [Smile warmly and clasp hands] Thank you, God, for Mommy!"

Slide 8 – Game: Find Mommy!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! Where is Mommy? [Look around searching] Can you touch Mommy? [Wait for tap] Yes! There is Mommy!"

Slide 9 – Game: Send a Kiss!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Touch Mommy and send her a kiss! [Wait for tap] Mwah! [Blow a kiss] Good job loving your family!"

Slide 10 – Real World Connection Where is Mommy?
Teacher Script & TPR: "Your turn! Is Mommy home? [Look expectantly] After class, go find Mommy! Blow her a kiss and say: Hello, Mommy! [Demonstrate blowing a kiss]"

Slide 11 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You did so well! Say: Mommy! [Wait] Say: Hello, Mommy! [Wait] Great job!"

Slide 12 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned another Family Heart for your garden! [Cheer] Thank you for loving your family. Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave]"

title: Letter E is for Egg
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Phonics short /e/ sound , Fine Motor Air tracing , Christian Value Thanking God for food/family
Target Vocabulary: E, e, Egg
Target Sentence: "E-E-Egg."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will visually recognize uppercase 'E' and lowercase 'e', produce the short /e/ sound, and associate the letter with "Egg."
Classroom Strategies: Clear enunciation. The teacher should make a wide, relaxed mouth shape for the short /e/ sound. Bring a plastic play egg or real egg carefully! to class.

Values Integration: Connect the word Egg to Mommy making breakfast for the family, emphasizing gratitude for family care and God's provision.
Success Indicators: The student can point to the letter 'E', repeat the /e/ sound, and perform the cracking egg TPR motion.

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome Back!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello again! [Wave both hands] Welcome back to RemoEd! Let's say hello to our friends. Say: Hello! [Cup ear]"

Slide 2 – Meet Letter E
Teacher Script & TPR: "We have a new letter today! [Look excited] This is the letter E. [Trace a big 'E' in the air] Big E. Small e. Can you say E? [Cup ear]"

Slide 3 – The /e/ Sound
Teacher Script & TPR: "What sound does E make? Listen to me. [Point to your mouth, relax jaw slightly] /e/ ... /e/ ... /e/. Your turn! Say: /e/ /e/ /e/! [Cup ear] Very good! [Clap hands]"

Slide 4 – E is for Egg
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look! /e/ /e/ Egg! [Hold up a play egg if available] E is for Egg. [Point to the letter E, then the Egg] Say: Egg! [Cup ear] Great job! E-E-Egg!"

Slide 5 – TPR Action: Crack the Egg
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's crack the egg! [Hold hands together like an egg, tap them on a pretend bowl] Tap, tap... CRACK! [Pull hands apart quickly] Say: /e/ /e/ Egg! Wow, you are a good cook!"

Slide 6 – Tracing Big E
Teacher Script & TPR: "Magic finger ready! Let's write big E! Straight line down! [Trace down] Now across, across, across! [Make three horizontal lines in the air] You do it!"

Slide 7 – Tracing Small e
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now small e! Draw a line across! [Trace horizontally] Now curve over and around! [Draw a C-shape around it] Good job writing e!"

Slide 8 – Values Integration: Mommy Cooks
Teacher Script & TPR: "Mommy cooks the yummy egg for breakfast! Mommy takes care of the family. We say: Thank you, Mommy! [Blow a kiss]"

Slide 9 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "God gives us yummy food to eat! [Rub tummy] Let's say thank you. [Clap hands together gently] Say: Thank you, God, for the egg! [Wait for repetition]"

Slide 10 – Game: Find the Big 'E'!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! Where is the Big E? [Look searching] Can you touch the Big E? [Wait for tap] Yes! There is the Big E!"

Slide 11 – Real World Connection Make an E!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Your turn! Get your magic finger! Can you draw an E in the air? Line down, across, across, across! [Demonstrate tracing] Show me! Wow!"

Slide 12 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are so smart! Say: E! [Wait] Say: /e/ /e/! [Wait] Say: Egg! [Wait] Fantastic! [Clap loudly]"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned an E-block for your garden! Look how smart you are! It is time to say goodbye. [Wave both hands] Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave]"

title: The Box is a Square
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Cognitive Shapes. Eco-Stewardship Nature/objects , Christian Value Sharing
Target Vocabulary: Square, Box
Target Sentence: "It is a square."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will identify the square shape, count its four sides, and recognize square objects like a box in their environment.
Classroom Strategies: Emphasize the four straight sides of a square by drawing it deliberately in the air. Bring a physical square box or block to class.

Values Integration: Connect the box a square to a gift box, teaching the Christian value of sharing with family.
Success Indicators: The student can draw a square in the air with their finger and say the word "Square."

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome Back!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello! It is so good to see you! [Wave both hands] Welcome back to RemoEd! Let's say hello to our friends. Say: Hello! [Cup ear]"

Slide 2 – Meet the Square
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at this new shape! What is it? Listen: Square. [Point to mouth] Say: Square. [Cup ear] Very good! It is a square!"

Slide 3 – Four Sides
Teacher Script & TPR: "The square has four straight lines! Let's count them! [Hold up fingers as you count] One, two, three, four! A square has four sides."

Slide 4 – TPR Action: Draw a Square!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's draw a square! Magic finger up! [Hold up finger] Across, down, across, up! [Draw a square in the air clearly] Say: Square! [Cup ear]"

Slide 5 – The Box is a Square
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look! [Point to screen] What shape is the box? The box is a square! [Draw a square in the air] Say: Box. [Cup ear]"

Slide 6 – The Book is a Square
Teacher Script & TPR: "What else is a square? A book! [Pretend to open a book in your hands] We read the square book with Mommy and Daddy!"

Slide 7 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "The box can be a gift! God wants us to share with our family. Sharing shows we love them! [Put hands over heart] Say: I share!"

Slide 8 – Game: Find the Square!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! [Put hands up] Where is the square? Touch the square with four sides! [Wait for tap] Yes! You found it!"

Slide 9 – Game: Find the Box!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Where is the square box? Look for the four sides! Touch the box! [Wait for tap] Good job! It is a square."

Slide 10 – Real World Connection Square Hunt!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now it is your turn! Look around your house! Can you find something square? A box or a book? [Wait enthusiastically. Celebrate when they return] Wow! It is a square!"

Slide 11 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "You did so well! Say: Square! [Wait] Say: Box! [Wait] Say: It is a square! [Wait] Fantastic job! [Clap loudly]"

Slide 12 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned a square toy box for your garden! [Cheer] Look at all your shapes! It is time to say goodbye. [Wave both hands] Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave]"

title: Bye-Bye Screen
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Eco-Stewardship Putting screens away for family , Christian Value God gave me my family
Target Vocabulary: Screen, Family

title: Letter F is for Family
description:

description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Fine Motor Mastery Horizontal line tracing , Values Integration Family journey
Target Vocabulary: Long, Road, Across
Target Sentence: "Review: Horizontal line tracing"
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will master independent horizontal line tracing by drawing multiple lines a "long road" across the screen.
Classroom Strategies: Encourage fluid, consistent motion from left to right.

Values Integration: The "long road" represents our journey as a family, walking together with God.
Success Indicators: The student can independently trace at least three parallel horizontal lines without stopping.

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello! Ready for a long road trip? Say: Hello!"

Slide 2 – The Road
Teacher Script & TPR: "It is a long road! Trace: Across!"

Slide 3 – Independent Tracing
Teacher Script & TPR: "Trace one road. Trace two roads! Trace three!"

Slide 4 – Motor Mastery
Teacher Script & TPR: "Ed walks across. You trace across!"

Slide 5 – Christian Value Integration
Teacher Script & TPR: "God walks with us on our road. Thank you, God!"

Slide 6 – Game: Longest Road
Teacher Script & TPR: "Trace to the finish line!"

Slide 7 – Real World Connection
Teacher Script & TPR: "Draw a long road on your paper!"

Slide 8 – Lesson Review ⭐
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are a tracing master!"

Slide 9 – Values: Family Together
Teacher Script & TPR: "Family walks together. Say: Family!"

Slide 10 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "Amazing tracing!"

Slide 11 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "Great work today!"

Slide 12 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You finished the road! Goodbye!"

title: Thank You, God, for Family
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Values Integration Gratitude for family
Target Vocabulary: Thank you, God, Family
Target Sentence: "Thank you, God."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Express gratitude for Mommy, Daddy, and the family God has provided.
Classroom Strategies: Reflective and thankful tone. Use hand-on-heart gestures.

Values Integration: Final reflection on the biblical design of the family and God as the provider.
Success Indicators: The student can repeat "Thank you, God" and identify family members.

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello everyone! [Wave both hands with a big smile] Welcome back to RemoEd! Today is a special day. We will say thank you to God for our family. Let's say hello to our friends! [Point to screen] Say: Hello! [Cup ear]"

Slide 2 – Thank You for Daddy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who is this special person? [Point to Daddy] Yes! It is Daddy! Say: Daddy! [Cup ear] We thank God for Daddy. [Hands on heart] Hands together. [Clasp hands] Say: Thank you, God!"

Slide 3 – Thank You for Mommy
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who is this special person? [Point to Mommy] Yes! It is Mommy! Say: Mommy! [Cup ear] We thank God for Mommy. [Blow a kiss] Hands together. [Clasp hands] Say: Thank you, God!"

Slide 4 – Our Family
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look! This is a family. [Trace a circle around the family] Mommy, Daddy, and children. God gave us our family. Say: Family! [Cup ear] Yes! Family!"

Slide 5 – Thank You, God!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's thank God! Hands together. [Clasp hands] Now, hands on your heart. [Place both hands on your heart] Smile and say: Thank you, God! [Cup ear] Beautiful! Thank you, God!"

Slide 6 – God Gave Me My Family
Teacher Script & TPR: "Who gave us this wonderful family? [Point up to the sky] God did! God gave me my family. [Hands on heart, then point up] Say: God gave me my family. [Cup ear] Thank you, God!"

Slide 7 – Game: Find the Family
Teacher Script & TPR: "Game time! [Put hands up] Where is the family? Can you touch the family? [Wait for the student to tap] Yes! There they are! That is the family! [Give a thumbs up] Say: Family!"

Slide 8 – Lesson Review
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's say our words! [Point to the family] Say: Family! [Cup ear] Now, hands together. [Clasp hands] Say: Thank you, God! [Cup ear] Great job!"

Slide 9 – Say Your Sentence!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's say our sentence. Hands together. [Clasp hands] Say: Thank you, God! [Cup ear] Excellent! Thank you, God!"

Slide 10 – Your Turn!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Now it is your turn! [Point to the student] Go find someone in your family! Give them a big hug and say: Thank you, God! [Wrap arms around yourself and squeeze] Go, go, go! [Cheer when they come back]"

Slide 11 – Thank You, God, for My Family
Teacher Script & TPR: "Let's thank God. Hands together. [Clasp hands and smile warmly] Say: Thank you, God, for my family. [Cup ear] Yes! Thank you, God, for my family."

Slide 12 – You Did It!
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are a star! [Clap loudly] Say: Family! [Cup ear] Say: Thank you, God! [Cup ear] Amazing!"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "You earned a family heart and an Eco-Drop for your garden! [Cheer and clap] Thank you, God, for family! It is time to say goodbye. [Wave both hands] Goodbye, see you next time! [Wave]"

title: Virtual Garden Challenge 1
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Gamification, Cognitive Mastery Shapes
Target Vocabulary: Circle, Square
Target Sentence: Mastery: Shapes e.g., "It is a circle/square."
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will demonstrate mastery of identifying circles and squares through an interactive digital game.
Classroom Strategies: The teacher acts as a game host, maintaining high energy and suspense. Correct identification triggers interactive rewards that help a digital seed grow.

Values Integration: Patience and knowing the needs of nature soil, water, light are essential to growth, mirroring how we nurture our families.
Success Indicators: The student can independently identify and name the shapes "Circle" or "Square" when prompted by the game.

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome to the Challenge!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello everyone! [Wave excitedly] Welcome to the Virtual Garden Shape Challenge! Are you ready to play? Give me a big thumbs up! [Show thumbs up]"

Slide 2 – The Sleeping Seed
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look! The seed is sleeping. Shh. [Finger to lips] We need to wake it up! To wake it up, we need to play the Shape Game!"

Slide 3 – Rules of the Game
Teacher Script & TPR: "Here are the rules. When you see a shape, you shout the name really loud! If you are right, the seed gets water! [Make pouring motion]"

Slide 4 – Level 1: What Shape?
Teacher Script & TPR: "Level one! Look at the shape! What is it? [Cup ear] CIRCLE! Yes! It is a circle!"

Slide 5 – Level 1 Reward: Watering the Seed
Teacher Script & TPR: "You said circle! Now we water the seed! [Pretend to hold watering can] Splash, splash, splash! Look, the seed is waking up!"

Slide 6 – Level 2: What Shape?
Teacher Script & TPR: "Level two! Here comes a new shape! What is this? [Point to screen and cup ear] SQUARE! Yes! It is a square! Draw a square in the air! [Trace square]"

Slide 7 – Level 2 Reward: More Water!
Teacher Script & TPR: "You said square! Here comes the rain! Down, down, down! [Wiggle fingers downward] Look! The plant is growing up!"

Slide 8 – Level 3: What Shape?
Teacher Script & TPR: "Level three! The hardest one! What is this? [Make big circle with arms] CIRCLE! Yes! It is a circle!"

Slide 9 – Level 3 Reward: Sunshine!
Teacher Script & TPR: "You said circle! The sun makes the plant warm. Look at your beautiful plant! You won!"

Slide 10 – Speed Round: Shapes!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Speed round! Shout them fast! [Point quickly] Circle! Square! Circle! Amazing!"

Slide 11 – Real World Connection Shape Hunt
Teacher Script & TPR: "Can you touch something circle? [Wait] Can you touch something square? [Wait] You are a shape master!"

Slide 12 – Challenge 1 Complete
Teacher Script & TPR: "You beat the Virtual Garden Challenge! Give me a high-five! [High-five the camera]"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "A giant Eco-Drop for beating Challenge 1! You are a master! It is time to say goodbye. [Wave] Goodbye!"

title: Virtual Garden Challenge 2
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Gamification, Phonics Mastery D, E, F
Target Vocabulary: D, E, F, Daddy, Egg, Family
Target Sentence: Mastery: Phonics.
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Students will demonstrate mastery of the phonics sounds /d/, /e/, and /f/.
Classroom Strategies: Emphasize vocal projection. The "magic" of the game requires shouting the correct sound to make the tree grow.

Values Integration: Our voices are gifts from God; we use them to learn and to express our love for family.
Success Indicators: The student can independently produce the /d/, /e/, and /f/ sounds when shown the corresponding letters.

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome to Challenge 2!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello! Welcome to Challenge Two! Today we play with magic sounds! Are you ready?"

Slide 2 – The Tiny Sapling
Teacher Script & TPR: "The tree wants to grow! Shout the magic sounds to help!"

Slide 3 – Rules of the Game
Teacher Script & TPR: "See a letter, shout the sound! Big voice!"

Slide 4 – Level 1: The Magic D
Teacher Script & TPR: "What letter? D! What sound? /d/ /d/ Daddy! Shout it!"

Slide 5 – Level 1 Reward: Growing Up!
Teacher Script & TPR: "It is growing! Good job!"

Slide 6 – Level 2: The Magic E
Teacher Script & TPR: "What letter? E! What sound? /e/ /e/ Egg! Shout it!"

Slide 7 – Level 2 Reward: Branches and Leaves!
Teacher Script & TPR: "The tree has leaves! Great /e/ sound!"

Slide 8 – Level 3: The Magic F
Teacher Script & TPR: "What letter? F! What sound? /f/ /f/ Family! Shout it!"

Slide 9 – Level 3 Reward: A Giant Tree!
Teacher Script & TPR: "The tree is huge! You won!"

Slide 10 – Speed Round: Phonics!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Magic sounds fast! /d/! /e/! /f/!"

Slide 11 – Real World Connection Loud and Quiet
Teacher Script & TPR: "Shout /d/ loud! Whisper /f/ quiet."

Slide 12 – Challenge 2 Complete ⭐
Teacher Script & TPR: "You beat Challenge 2! Phonics master!"

Slide 13 – Goodbye & Virtual Garden Reward
Teacher Script & TPR: "ABC tree is amazing! Goodbye!"

title: Monthly Celebration
description:
Unit: Month 2 - The Family God Gave Me
Core Pillars: Positive Reinforcement, Values, Conclusion
Target Vocabulary: Goodbye, Eco-Drops
Target Sentence: "Goodbye!"
teacherNotes:
TEACHER GUIDEBOOK

Teaching Goals: Provide a high-energy capstone to celebrate the student's completion of Month 2.
Classroom Strategies: Maximum energy, celebratory props, and fast-paced review focusing on praise.

Values Integration: Celebrating the journey of learning and thanking God for the family and knowledge gained this month.
Success Indicators: The student is engaged, enthusiastic, and clearly says "Goodbye".

2. FULL SLIDE CURRICULUM : 13 SLIDES

Slide 1 – Welcome to the Party!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Hello! Welcome to our Monthly Celebration! You finished Month 2! Yay!"

Slide 2 – The Garden!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Look at your beautiful garden! You built this!"

Slide 3 – Shape Champion
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are a shape champion! Circle and Square!"

Slide 4 – Phonics Champion
Teacher Script & TPR: "Phonics champion! /d/, /e/, /f/!"

Slide 5 – Family Champion
Teacher Script & TPR: "Family champion! We love our family!"

Slide 6 – Eco-Stewardship: Good Job Caring!
Teacher Script & TPR: "You are great at caring for the earth!"

Slide 7 – Christian Value: Thank You, God!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Say: Thank you, God, for my family!"

Slide 8 – The Eco-Drop Shower!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Catch the Eco-Drops!"

Slide 9 – Dance Party!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Time to dance!"

Slide 10 – A Big Hug!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Big virtual hug for you!"

Slide 11 – Tell Your Family!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Tell your family how smart you are!"

Slide 12 – Ready for Month 3!
Teacher Script & TPR: "Ready for Month 3?"

Slide 13 – The Big Goodbye!
Teacher Script & TPR: "GOODBYE! See you next month!"
